text: We raised our price and got more customers, and the reason is embarrassing.
Let me show you the old price page.
Three plans, a free trial, and a calculator nobody used.
You'd guess the cheaper plans convert better.
On a call, a customer told us our price made the app look like a toy.
So we doubled the starter plan and wrote one sentence about who it is for.
Trials went down and paid plans went up.
The calculator is still there, and still nobody uses it.
A price is a sentence about who you serve.
We asked for more money, and people finally took us seriously.
